newsitem.title: LATVIA: GOV'T LOOKING FOR OIL SPILL FUNDS.
newsitem.headline: GOV'T LOOKING FOR OIL SPILL FUNDS.

text.p: Latvia said on Monday it is looking for funds to finance equipment for combatting oil disasters at sea, worth 12 million lats.
"According to the sea administration data, we would need some 12 million lats to finance the necessary equipment," Vilis Krishtopans, the transport minister, told a news conference.
Latvia might seek financing from the PAHRE programme's environment funds for the equipment, which would include six barges and three spillage retrieval ships, Kristopans said.
Krishtopans specified the proposed Butinges oil terminal on the Baltic coast of Lithuania as a possible site for a major oil spill.
He said it was risky to build an open-sea terminal in a region often hit by storms, even in summer.
"With Butinge we will feel an ecological threat," Krishtopans said.
